The institutional investor held 91,470 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $15.35M, down from 93,348 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Kanawha Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $923.56 billion market cap company.
